title: json_buf retention audit + high-threshold reclaim
impact: Diagnostic + reclaim. Adds `Diagnostics.readerJsonBufHighWaterBytes` (sum of per-reader `json_buf.cap`) so the bounded RSS high-water exp 174 left as a known trade-off is now directly observable. Pathological retention is real on a one-off concurrent-burst workload (8 × 8 MB `selectBytes` pins **32 MB** across the 4-reader pool for the rest of the connection's life) and on a recurring-large pattern (16 MB pinned). A high-threshold C-side `realloc` shrink — fired by the reader worker after `SendPort.send` on a `selectBytes` reply when `json_buf.cap > 1 MB` AND the just-sent result was < 256 KB — reclaims back to the 16 KB initial cap on subsequent small reads: **post-burst settle 32 MB → 64 KB** (×4 readers, summed); recurring-large **16 MB → 64 KB**. Neutral on the focused `large_bytes_transfer.dart` lanes (±2 % within run-to-run noise). The 256 KB last-len guard is what makes the policy safe under back-to-back large reads — they keep their warm capacity
